verdict.rationale: The evidence shows read access to Klaviyo data through public APIs and the MCP server, including paginated event retrieval. That is a developer building block a user could script into an export, not a documented first-party feature to export all account data in open formats. No bulk export, CSV/JSON account export, or offboarding capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
